verdict.rationale: Render documents a real opt-out for usage telemetry in its own CLI: setting RENDER_CLI_DISABLE_ANALYTICS or the standard DO_NOT_TRACK environment variable disables it at any time. The evidence covers only the CLI, so whether tracking can be turned off in the dashboard, MCP server, or other agent tooling is unknown. missing for 10: opt-out controls for the dashboard, MCP server, plugins and skills, documentation of what data is collected, account-level privacy settings, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: You can disable telemetry at any time by setting either the `RENDER_CLI_DISABLE_ANALYTICS` or `DO_NOT_TRACK` environment variables.
